To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the magnetic field can have a dramatic influence on the evolution of a shocked cloud.
the magnetic fields in shocked clouds can significantly alter the evolution of those clouds and the resulting emission.

(i) the magnetic field geometry has a profound impact on the dynamics of the interaction, (ii) the magnetic field strength has a significant effect on the cloud evolution, even for weak magnetic fields, (iii) the magnetic field is amplified by a factor of 10 to 1000, and (iv) the magnetic field amplification is strongly dependent on the initial field orientation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the interaction between a strong planar magnetohydrodynamic shock and a dense spherical cloud.
the magnetohydrodynamic interaction of a spherical cloud with a planar shock.
the interaction of a strong shock wave with a spherical cloud of gas in the presence of a magnetic field.

the magnetic field is a very important factor in determining the structure and dynamics in the shock-cloud interaction.
magnetic fields are important for the dynamics and thermal evolution of shocked clouds.

magnetic fields of any strength and orientation will have a significant effect on the evolution and structure of shocked clouds, and that the effects of the field are most pronounced at the later stages of the interaction.
